_meta.note: The other half of the mount story, and an operational hazard rather than a capability: a stdio element whose command cannot start fails the WHOLE session/new and rolls the unpublished session back, naming the server -- mcp-client(<name>): initial connection or tool synchronization failed. It does NOT drop the offending element the way codex-acp does. So one pooled broker stub that cannot start costs a deepseek session entirely, which is recorded in the host contract's loader-strictness row.
